human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add generic read-side models for lifecycle, execution outcome, validation, work structure, runtime roles/backends, changes, decision records, evidence refs, and projection version. Do not put EverRun-specific planner/coder/pack fields into mandatory core shape. Dependency: 8009.add-projection-storage.
human_pressure.why_now: The product needs a stable deterministic object between raw evidence and Run Report/Dashboard.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Define strict source-neutral ExecutionProjection models with orthogonal lifecycle/outcome/validation/scope dimensions.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8009.add-projection-storage. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
All negative/warning details can carry evidence refs.
contracts: Model follows documented decision-domain and data-flow ADRs.
failure_semantics: Missing derivable fact becomes unknown, not pass/clean.

steps.title: Define role/change/decision summary models
details: Decision record carries explicit domain and source decision value.

acceptance: Lifecycle, outcome, validation, and scope are distinct fields.
DecisionRecord does not unify decision vocabularies.
Model can represent a runtime without planner/coder/judge.

must_check: Unknown is never aliased to success.
reject_if: Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
